name: harness-start
description: Harness Start plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: verification-provenance-guard
plugins.description: Requires machine-checkable provenance for test, artifact, Git, and CI conclusions in completion responses.

plugins.name: execution-loop-guard
plugins.description: Detects repeated edits, blind command retries, and excessive remote polling before agents waste a session.

plugins.name: source-sanity-guard
plugins.description: Blocks backup artifacts, obvious replacement-character corruption, and unresolved merge markers in source files.

plugins.name: code-quality-guard
plugins.description: Runs bounded JS/TS, Python, and PHP syntax, lint, and static-analysis checks after file edits.

plugins.name: encoding-guard
plugins.description: Encoding guard: blocks BOM-bearing and invalid UTF-8 text files after AI writes.

plugins.name: file-line-budget-guard
plugins.description: Ratchet-enforced file line budget guard: prevents source files from exceeding per-language line limits.

plugins.name: protected-file-guard
plugins.description: Blocks direct file-tool edits to dependency lockfiles and package-manager-owned dependency directories.

plugins.name: command-safety-guards
plugins.description: Command safety guards: deny broad recursive deletion, unbacked sed in-place edits, and cat heredoc writes outside temporary directories.

plugins.name: process-confidence
plugins.description: Observable delivery process: validated session begin, hook receipts, auto complete, Stop gate (hooks never auto-begin).

plugins.name: in-chinese
plugins.description: Keeps agent prose in Simplified Chinese and blocks long Korean, Japanese, or Thai language drift at response boundaries.

plugins.name: subagent-discipline
plugins.description: Injects subagent contract and return hygiene; with agent_id, ledger TTL cleanup, gitignore ensure, optional Stop gate.
